title: Power Basics
subtitle: From starter grids to factory buses
summary: Use PowerGrid to build a readable EP network before scaling machines.
body: Start with a starter generator, one battery, and a short cable run. In 1.0.0, Tech packs can progress into reinforced solar panels, biofuel generators, field battery banks, high-voltage cable, and factory substations. Keep each grid small enough to inspect, then use RuntimeGuard and HoloMap markers before scaling automation.
